title: Internal: Retrieving Debit Card Information
summary: This document explains how to retrieve debit card information for a customer checking account using tool get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823(account_id). It lists returned debit card fields (e.g., status, issue_reason, expiration_date, daily_purchase_limit, daily_atm_limit) and notes privacy and that only checking-account debit cards are returned as an empty list if none exist.
faqs: How do I use get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 to retrieve debit cards for a specific checking account ID?
What fields does the tool return for each debit card (card_id, status, issue_reason, expiration_date, limits, etc.)?
Can this tool return full debit card numbers, or only partial information (last 4)?
What statuses can be returned for a card (ACTIVE, PENDING, FROZEN, CLOSED)?
If a checking account has multiple cards in history, how many results can be returned?
What happens if the account has no debit cards—does it return an error or an empty list?
